name: @knf/assistantengine
description: The faculty app's assistant runtime seam for React Native / Expo — a transport that carries the session, the language and the client version to the AI container, maps every wire failure to one typed code, time-boxes only the wait for headers, and a runtime hook that auto-continues after server-executed tools. Owns the frozen tool-name contract and its JSON-schema mirrors; the upstream runtime and stream protocol are imported here and nowhere else.
